faq_heading: Beach Grove houses: your questions answered

faq.q: What did houses in Beach Grove sell for?
faq.a: 22 houses sold in Beach Grove between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,571,250.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Beach Grove?
faq.a: The median was 27 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.2% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Beach Grove sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 22 houses that sold in Beach Grove went for between $1,391,250 and $1,968,750, around a median of $1,571,250.

faq.q: Do houses in Beach Grove sell above asking price?
faq.a: 9% of the 22 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.2% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Beach Grove?
faq.a: The median year built was 1986 for the 22 houses sold in Beach Grove.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Beach Grove usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Beach Grove had 4 bedrooms, from the 22 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

blocks.text: Beach Grove houses for sale now
What Beach Grove houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

22 houses sold in Beach Grove with a median price of $1,571,250 (the middle half sold between $1,391,250 and $1,968,750), taking a median of 27 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $777 per square foot, a median year built of 1986 and a median lot of 5,834 square feet.
How Beach Grove compares with the rest of Tsawwassen

The median house in Beach Grove sold for $1,571,250, 5% above the Tsawwassen median of $1,499,500 across 158 sales. Beach Grove houses took a median 27 days to sell, against 20 days for Tsawwassen as a whole.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a community is listed only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.
